title: SQP Audit
headline: {store} wins 2.1% of purchases across 480 searches, with about 900 more orders within reach.
subline: Its share of clicks runs above its share of impressions; the gap opens after the click, where conversion is 0.82x the market.

takeaways.funnel: Share rises from impressions to clicks, then eases at purchase. The next gain is conversion.
takeaways.leaks: Ten searches hold about a third of the opportunity; most of it is after the click.
takeaways.portfolio: A few searches already convert above market with a low share - ready for more traffic once ad cost agrees.
takeaways.concentration: Sales lean on the top 10 searches more than the market does; the next 20 are open ground.
takeaways.ads: Several searches return ad ROAS near the store average yet convert below the market - a gap only market data shows.
takeaways.products: One product carries most of the below-market searches; check which searches drive it before changing the page.
takeaways.gaps: Large relevant searches where the store has under 1% of impressions are head terms - the most expensive clicks.
takeaways.protect: On searches where the store wins 20%+ of purchases, keep exact coverage.

actions.action: Fix the page on the top three below-market searches before adding spend
actions.why: Conversion 0.7x the market on 600 store clicks
actions.measure: Conversion vs market from 0.70x toward 0.90x after 2 SQP weeks

actions.action: Run plan mode for the category to size raises and cuts to the budget
actions.why: Two searches convert above market with under 10% share
actions.measure: Purchase share on those searches after 2 SQP weeks

limits: Synthetic example: every number and id here is made up for illustration.
